hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && f=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard docs/prompts/ 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] && jq -n --arg f "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("\u26a0 UNPROCESSED INBOUND cross-repo message(s) in docs/prompts/. Radio Console writes these and never commits them, so untracked = unread. Read each one BEFORE other work, then commit it \u2014 an uncommitted inbound file is one git checkout from being lost:\n" + $f)}}' || true
